primitives.note: Mist stacks (gained by consuming marks or Mist Wraiths) grant permanent bonus AD (0.75/stack, no stated cap or decay found) and, every 20 stacks, bonus crit chance (10%); stack count also feeds R's shield scaling.
Every 1% of total crit chance (items + Mist tiers) above 100% converts to 0.35% life steal.
Consuming a Mist mark deals bonus physical damage equal to a level-scaled percent of the target's current health (1%/level, capped at 10% from level 10), applying life steal at 100%.
A hit applies a 4s Mist mark to the target; consuming it renders the target immune to being re-marked for a level-scaled duration (6s down to 4s).
Relic Cannon: basic attacks on-hit deal 20% AD bonus physical damage (100% life steal) if damage >0; Piercing Darkness applies on-hit effects to the champion it triggers on-attack against.
Piercing Darkness' current cooldown is reduced by 1 second on every on-attack (basic attack landed), independent of Q's own casts.
Q, W and R each deal one fixed physical damage instance per cast, scaling with bonus AD/AP and level/rank.
Mana costs (Q 70-110, W 50-70, E 70 flat, R 100 flat) could cap casts inside a 15s fight depending on mana pool/regen.

Basic attacks can crit using crit chance granted by Mist-stack tiers; a bin value (CritDamageMod=0.8) may modify Senna's own critical strike damage multiplier but is not tied to any named calculation.
E's camouflage and movement speed, and R's shield to self/allies, are never read by a damage-only fight against a stationary dummy.

needsBespoke.why: Every offensive mechanic (mark-and-consume, stacking AD/crit from Mist, crit-to-lifesteal conversion, Relic Cannon on-hit, Q's on-attack cooldown refund, and Q/W/R's plain-cast damage) maps onto a primitive in the closed list. The remaining difficulty is entirely about how those primitives interact over time against a single continuously-attacked target (the mark/immunity duty cycle and resulting stack growth), which is a rotation/timing question rather than a missing mechanic type.

unsettled.question: How does the Mist mark / consume / re-mark-immunity cycle play out against one continuously attacked target over 15s (does every other hit alternate apply/consume, and does the ~4-6s immunity window throttle this at high attack speed)?
options: Simulate the full state machine per hit (unmarked -> mark applied -> consumed on next hit -> immune for N seconds -> repeat), which caps the rate of conditional-damage procs and Mist-stack gains regardless of attack speed
Approximate as a fixed proc rate (e.g., one consume per immunity-duration window) for simplicity
Treat every attack/ability hit as marking+consuming simultaneously (ignore the immunity gate), overcounting stack gain and current-health damage
quotes: Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}... rendering the target immune to being marked again for a few seconds.

unsettled.question: Does SennaPassive.CritDamageMod (0.8) modify Senna's own critical strike damage multiplier (e.g., her crits do 180% instead of 200%), or is it unused/tied to something else (e.g., Mist Wraiths)?
options: It reduces Senna's own crit damage multiplier to 180%, affecting all basic-attack crit damage in the dummy fight
It is unused for Senna's own attacks and should be ignored

unsettled.question: What starting Mist stack count should be assumed at the beginning of the damage fight (affects starting bonus AD, crit chance tier, and R's shield-from-stacks term)?
options: 0 stacks (no prior kills/marks before the timed fight begins)
Some nonzero baseline representing a typical mid-game stack count, left to the simulator's item/level assumptions

proposal: Open with a basic attack or Q (Piercing Darkness) to apply the first Mist mark on the dummy, since the dummy counts as an enemy champion for marking purposes.
Weave continuous basic attacks throughout the fight to trigger Relic Cannon's on-hit bonus damage and to consume/re-apply Mist marks for the current-health-percent bonus damage and Mist stack gain.
Cast Q on cooldown once available; note Q's own cooldown is refunded 1s per basic attack landed (on-attack), so Q comes off cooldown faster the more Senna is actively auto-attacking.
Cast W (Last Embrace) on cooldown for its flat physical damage instance, timed so its hit also lands on the target to interact with the mark cycle.

Cast R (Dawning Shadow) as soon as it is available for its large physical-damage instance (250-550 + 0.7 AP + 1.15 bonus AD); given its long cooldown relative to a 15s window, it will likely be cast at most once, so cast it as early as safely possible to maximize total damage dealt in the window.
Do not cast E (Curse of the Black Mist) during the damage fight: it deals no damage and its camouflage/movement-speed effects are mobility/stealth, which the fight ignores.
questions: Given the mark/immunity duty cycle, is there an attack-speed threshold beyond which extra basic attacks stop producing extra conditional-damage procs (i.e., is the cycle rate-limited by the mark's immunity duration rather than attack speed)?

Should R be front-loaded at the very start of the 15s window (maximizing chance to land once) or held to combo with a Q/W mark-consume for the current-health-percent proc, and does R's own hit count as an 'ability hit' that can apply or consume the Mist mark like Q and W do?
Does the simulator need to model Senna gaining a Mist Wraith kill from the dummy dying mid-fight (extra stack + gold), or is the dummy assumed to have effectively infinite health for the 15s window?
